string.text: You know, Marked One, that tinned meat they sell may lead to botulism and twisted bowels... And the vodka around here is sure to be unlicensed, may cause liver lesions... The sausage is well past its expiry date as well, better let some dogs try it before you eat it...
A mature bloodsucker teaches a young one. "You must attack people in such a way that they have time to see you and react." "Why so?" "'Cause they're much tastier when there's no more shit in 'em!"

A wonderful picture. Zone at the sunset. The orange and red sun is casting shadows around tall trees and low bushes. Clouds on the sky are soaked with colors. In between all of these, at the large fallen tree near the cave, sits gray and blue swamp bloodsucker. Out of the cave, laughing and yelling, three little bloodsuckers are coming. They immediately start teasing and pulling their father by the tentacles, hitting him with the claws. "Papa, papa, show us the two stalkers!" And papa pulls out two skulls from under the large fallen tree, takes them into his hands and speaks in different voices... The left skull says... "Hey, Mitya, are you sure that there are no bloodsuckers in this cave?" The right skull answers... "Absolutely none, Kolya, nobody has ever seen 'em here..."

A Monolith militant is walking through a wood and sees a bloodsucker. He drops to his knees and preys: "Oh, Great and Almighty Monolith! Please, fill the soul of this creature of yours with intelligence and religiousness!" Instantly, the bloodsucker also drops to his knees and lifts up hands to heavens: "Oh, Great and Wise Monolith! Please, bless the food I'm going to partake of now!"

The inner perimeter of the Zone. A rookie approaches a stalker's house and knocks at the fence. Silence. He knocks again. No response. He pulls himself up a bit and sees a dog in the yard. The dog says: "Why do you keep on knocking? Don't ya see there's nobody at home?" The rookie faints for a while. Having regained his senses he opens the eyes and sees the dog standing by his side. "Hey, Doggy, can't you bark?" "I can, I just didn't want to scare you..."

Three stalkers made a bet, who will dare to cast largest number of people outside the 100 Rads bar, by any means necessary. The first day, the first stalker entered the 100 Rads bar swinging with a PKM machine gun loaded with a 150-rounds belt of 7.62, and shouted loud: "Everyone out, fast!" Some of the rookies did run out, but the remaining stalkers quickly and easily disarmed him and taught him a good lesson. The second day, the second stalker found somewhere a dried and preserved bloodsucker's head, stuck his own head into it, dressed off bare naked and, roaring like a mad, ran into the 100 Rads Bar. Most of the stalkers jumped out of the doors and windows, but a few remaining veterans and a Duty squad pulled the bloodsucker's head off him and taught him a good lesson. The third day, the third stalker entered the 100 Rads bar in his old and worn suit, and with an almost broken AKSU on his shoulder. He ordered a drink, took a sip and started coughing... "A... arg... a... cough... cou... aarg... uuh. Damned tuberculosis..."

One morning, a blind dog came in front of a pack of rodents. "Is there a brave one among you, guys?!" Complete silence. "Then, if there's none, each one of you must bring me an artifact by tomorrow." The next morning the blind dog came again, and so did it the day after. In the third evening, the rodents held a meeting. "Let's call a pseudodog to assist us!" So they did. On the fourth day, even before the blind dog could say anything, the pseudodog appeared. "I am the brave one here", it said loudly. Then, from the bushes and trees behind the blind dog a Controller appeared: "If you are the only brave one here, you will bring me ten artifacts by tomorrow. The rest of you, the non-brave ones, just one each."

Two stalkers are chattering by the campfire. "What kind of a car a real stalker needs?!" "I do not know. A reliable one?" "Yes. And with a rear placed engine, and an open trunk at the front." "Why so?" "So that you always know where your loot is."

Three old residents of the Zone start chatting: "Eh, I remember, just after the explosion apples kept growing so big... I took one home, placed it on a chair, and the chair collapsed!" "Ya don't say! I harvested an apple once too, put it on my table - the table collapsed!" "That's all nuts! Once I was driving a cart and saw a really big apple. I harvested it, put it in the cart..." The other two, simultaneously: "The cart collapsed?" "No. A worm came out and swallowed my horse."

Once, three bloodsuckers started arguing, which one of them was the most bloodthirsty and malicious. Finally, they drew lots, in what order they would hunt. The first one comes back in an hour, with pleased eyes and his whole head covered in blood. The rest ask him: "How? What? Where?" "Do you see that tree?" "Well, yes." "So, three stalkers decided to take a rest under it. I killed them and drank their blood - there was plenty!" The second one goes hunting. Gets back in two hours: head, paws, chest - all covered with blood. The fellows start asking him. "Do you see that tree over there?" "Yes." "So, a group of bandits had set a small camp there. I killed them all and drank their blood." The third bloodsucker went hunting. One hour passes, two hours - no sign of him. His friends almost started thinking he had run into an anomaly or got slain by somebody, when, finally, he appeared staggering towards them, all covered with blood. "And where have you been???!!!" "Do you see that far-most tree over there?" "Yes, we do..." "But I didn't!!!..."

A veteran stalker got tired of rambling all over the Zone. So he decided to settle down in some abandoned house and make his living by farming. Once a rookie stalker comes to visit him and asks: "Haven't seen you in the Zone for a long time. Where have you been?" "I'm not going into the Zone ever again, I've got sick and tired of it. I'm satisfied with living here, farming and all... Come, take a look at my garden." The rookie takes a walk about the garden and gets excited! "Such big watermelons! Never saw anything like that! And the vegetable marrows are just wonderful! So nice here! And the nightingale sings so nicely! You've got an excellent garden!" The veteran sighs and says: "Just a garden, nothing special: those are not watermelons but gooseberries, not marrows but pea pods... And it's not a nightingale but a Geiger counter..."

Duty and Freedom are fighting at the Army Warehouses. Rifles and shotguns blazing everywhere... One can hear, loud and clear, the Freedom fighters' commander shouting: "Freedom fighters! Stand up! In the name of Freedom! Attack!" In a trench on the Duty side a veteran and some newbies are taking cover. One of the newbies asks: "Is it time to retreat yet? Are they coming?" "No." Says the veteran calmly and fires a couple of shots from his rusty RPK. Freedomers quickly throw themselves on the ground. After a few moments of silence, again, from the Freedom side, commander's shouting: "Freedom fighters! Stand up! For the peaceful Zone! Attack!" "Now, will we retreat? They will kill us all!!" Cries the newbie. "No." Says the veteran calmly and throws a hand grenade. Freedomers quickly throw themselves on the ground. After a longer silence, the leader of the Freedom squad stands up, his outfit all in dust and mud, his out-of-the-box assault-rifle all dirty and his face covered with boar's turd... "WTF?!?!?! You, bastards!!!" The veteran pulls out the feeding belt from his rusty RPK, and says calmly to the newbies: "NOW, it is time to retreat."

Two rookies once had to stay over night in the Zone. So, they set up a fire by some tree and got ready to go to bed... Suddenly, they heard some rustle from the bushes! And a bloodsucker sprang out of there and rushed towards one of the stalkers! The stalker started climbing the tree but the bloodsucker managed to get hold of his foot... The stalker shouted to his fellow: "Shoot him! Shoot!" The latter immediately grabbed his rifle, aimed and shot off the bloodsucker's left nut! But the bloodsucker just groaned and still kept holding its victim. "Shoot him!!! Shoot him down, man!!!" The stalker aimed again and shot off the bloodsucker's right nut... The stalker from the tree sees the situation and shouts again: "Look, man, shoot him IN THE HEAD! I'm quite certain the monster is not at all going to fuck me!"

Two Dutyers are guarding the Duty HQ at the Bar.
 "Old Barkeep next door's a-makin' �StalkerOFFka� again." One Dutyer tells his fellow.
 "How can you tell?" he asked. "Did you smell it?"
 "Nope. But a bunch of mice from over his place came over the southern checkpoint this morning and beat the shit out of those mutated cats . . ."

Some tourist is bumming around the Zone, chewing a bubble gum, admiring the scenery, listening to some nice music on his iPod and all... Suddenly he stumbles upon some tall guy wearing old blue jeans. The guy asks: "Who are you?" "Eh, me? I... I am a tourist." "Nope. I AM a tourist. And you must be the "Tourist's delight"..."

One mobster asks another one: "Vovan, why did ya give up studies on how to play the guitar?" The other one answers: "You know, the guitar has got 6 strings, and I've got only 5 fingers." "Aha... What kind of mutants play the piano then, I wonder?!"

Head of the military intelligence is making a report in the Ministry of Defense: "It has been known that there are numerous bandits and smugglers within the Zone territory. They are mostly involved in smuggling artifacts out of the Zone and smuggling weapons into it. Besides, many criminals are escaping from justice to be administered. To put an end to that we have been injecting our agents under cover into the Zone." "Have you achieved any success?" "Indeed, we have! Presently, there are 5 gangs in the Zone, which consist entirely of our agents!"

A stalker got to the Sarcophagus. He explores the interior and finally gets to the room, in which the legendary Monolith stands. And there he sees it: a huge, black phallus! The phallus addresses to the stalker in a human voice: "Thou path is at an end, human! Come closer!" The stalker approaches slowly: "Ah, well... What... or who are you? The Monolith?" "No, not at all." "But who then?!" "Look, man, have you ever been told to go and fuck yourself?" "Yes..." "So, you've come to the right place!"

An old stalker is being questioned by a journalist at the army outpost. "People say you carry assault rifles, hand grenades... is it true?!" "Well, people nowadays say a lot of things." "People say you even have machine guns, rocket launchers... " "Well, people nowadays say a lot of things." "People say you have all kinds of... girls, at your bar, well, you know... "Uhm... oh my... oh my... what we don't have, we don't have."

Once upon a time two robbers are sitting by the fire, a veteran and a rookie. The veteran keeps smoking a blunt. The rookie asks him: "They say you have seen a pseudodog two meters high with two heads and enormous balls... Is that true???" The veteran holds him the blunt: "Inhale it and hold your breath. You may see something even more mysterious yourself!"
Why do bloodsuckers have big noses?\n Because they have big fingers.
A stalker comes to see the Swamp Doctor. "Help me, Doctor, I cannot help scratching myself!" Doctor examines the guy. "Did you try taking a shower?" "I did. But the problem recurs after a month..."
The bloodsucker saw some stalker in an exoskeleton and said with a sigh: "Dammit, canned food again..."

A horde of fleshes keeps running in circles. Suddenly the leader stops and says: "So, brethren... Have we made GREAT noise?" "Yes, we have!" "Have we raised TONNES of dust in the air?" "Yes, yes, we have!!!" "We are almost like HORSES, then!"

One day a stalker entered the crowded bar and ordered himself some beer. Then he looked around for a spare seat and noticed only one in the far most corner of the bar, with some lad with a tamed pseudodog by the table. When the stalker approached them, the lad introduced himself to the stalker and tried to sell him the dog. "This is a talking dog," he said. "And you can have him for five rubles." The stalker said, "Who do you think you're kidding with this talking dog stuff? There ain't no such animal." Suddenly the dog looked up with tears in his eyes. "Please buy me, Sir," he pleaded. "This man is cruel. He never buys me a meal, never pets me, treats me badly. And I used to be the strongest and wisest pseudodog in the Zone! I can find artifacts in concealed places. I was in the army and was saving lives by discovering mine traps. I know a quick walk-through to the Monolith itself!" "Hey!" said the stalker. "He can talk. Why do you want to sell him for just five rubles?" "Because," said the seller, "I'm getting tired of all his lies."

A stalker is passing through an old cemetery and sees a zombie drinking vodka and having fun with three naked girls... "Look, friend, be so kind, share one with me, please!" "Why always like that? "Be kind, share"... Take a shovel and help yourself!"

"Hello, stalkers! You are probably going to the Monolith for fulfillment of your wishes?" "That's right! You are reading our thoughts!" "Nice! "Our thoughts"... Are you sure they are actually YOURS?" - the controller asked venomously...

A stalker was in the Zone for several years and decided to leave for normal life. He paid Sidorovich to arrange it with the military to let him out through the checkpoint. He also let his wife know about the plans so that she would come to meet him. On due time his wife and son were there to pick him up. He came through the gates of the checkpoint and got into the car. The only thing he said was, "F.F." His wife turned to him and answered, "E.F." Out on the highway, he said, "F.F." She responded simply, "E.F." He repeated, "F.F." She again replied, "E.F." "Mom! Dad!" their son yelled. "What's going on?" The stalker answered, "Your mother wants to eat first!"

Two loners and a Dutyer died and went to Heaven. So Apostle Peter tells them: "You have performed good deeds and lived a life of righteousness. So, what would you want people to say about you at your funerals?" First stalker: "I want to be always remembered to have been a good fellow who had always helped others in need, sharing the last medkit with a companion." "So be it. What about you?", St. Peter asks the Dutyer. "And I want people to say that I was an irreconcilable and glorious fighter against mutants and the Zone." "Thou will has been fulfilled. So, what would you want?", Peter asks the remaining stalker. "I want people at my funeral to say: "Look! He's alive!!!"

After a long vodka treatment against radiation and �Horror Time� those two lone stalkers discuss whether the moon is red or green. Since they can't come to a conclusion they go searching for a referee. Finally they find a Freedomer and ask him: "Please, could you tell us if the moon is red or green?" The Freedomer inhales his cigarette, looks up and asks back: "The left or the right one?"

Two stalkers were in the bar drinking when suddenly one lurched backward off his bar-stool and lay motionless on the floor. "One thing about Sasha," his buddy said to Barkeep, "he knows when to stop."

A stalker says to another one: "You smell like shit! Why?" "Well, you see... Kolya and I were tracking down a controller. Kolya somehow lagged behind and I discovered the controller's den, put on the psi-helmet and started crouching in... Suddenly I felt a hand on my shoulder!.. I turned around and, actually, realized it was Kolya... But couldn't help it anyway..."

A stalker is returning back home after a deep raid. Pale face, staggering gait... Something is obviously wrong. His friends see him and rush rush to meet him, hand him medkits, vodka and all. "Vasya, what's wrong with you?" "Mmm..." "Milk? Want some milk?" "Mmmmm...." "Monolithians? Monolith fanatics have wounded you?!" "Mmmmmmm..... MMMMURDER YOU!!!!!!!!!!!"

A pseudogiant and a flesh are heading through the Zone. They walk slowly and seem to be overwhelmed by grief... Suddenly the pseudogiant stops, turns his face to the Flesh and says sadly: "I told you, Piglet! Those were wrong bees and they made wrong honey! Normal honey never glows in the dark..."

Two stalkers have met in the Zone, near the Red Forest. "How are you?" "Hi! I'm fine." "Look, why have you got this strange nickname: "One Dick"?" "Ok, listen. I was born here before the 1st Catastrophe broke out. After that disaster took place, I remained here. So did I after the 2nd Catastrophe as well. And the environment here is not pretty good in the ecological aspect, you know. You must have noticed that I've got 4 arms, 3 legs, 30 fingers, 3 ears... Now guess, what question they used to ask me MOST FREQUENTLY?.."

A stalker addresses himself to his fellow:
 �Man, have you got a drinking problem!�
 Fellow: �The hell I do!�
Stalker: �The hell you don't!�
Fellow: �I don't have a drinking problem. I drink...I get drunk...I fall down.
No problem!�
Two pseudofleas are dwelling on a pseudodog. One turns to the other and asks: "What do you think, are there same anomalies on other pseudodogs as well?"

Three students at a lecture keep chattering in a whisper: "I had a dream yesterday, that I happened to be at the Chernobyl NPP! There were hordes of mutants there and they tore me to pieces!" "Wow! I had an almost identical dream!" "So had I! Incredible!" Some time passed. The first student failed his exams and was called up for the military service. He got his posting at the Chernobyl NPP. During a clean-up operation against mutants he ran out of ammo... The second student did his best in his studies and graduated from the institute with a distinction degree. He successfully defended a thesis and joined a laboratory which carried out researches on mutants. Being a remarkable young specialist he got an academic mission to Yantar. One night he happened to forget to close the bunker doors properly... The third student was doing average effort with his studies and graduated from the institute. But he did not manage to get any work so he went to the Zone and became a stalker. He successfully passed Cordon, walked through the Garbage and the Bar within one night. Finally he got to some abandoned village by the Warehouses, when suddenly... The only thing he managed to say was "My god!"... "These must be nothing more than just singular coincidences..." - their old professor thought to himself. He set his chequered shirt straight, pulled up the blue jeans and walked away...
A bandit gets into the sarcophagus and sees the Monolith: \n"Blast me dead!!! It's the Wish Granter!!!"

A stalker is going his way through the Zone, enjoying the sunset and bothering nobody. One moment he decides to take a leak. So he goes into some bushes, opens the fly of his trousers... And there's a voice from there: "Close it! Don't ya feel it's cold outside?! Wanna make me catch a flu?!!"

A stalker was making his way through an underground laboratory complex. Suddenly a brick fell just in front of him! "Well, I never!" - the stalker exclaimed. "Well, I always..." - the poltergeist thought and threw another brick.

Two drunk stalkers walk into the bar. The first drunk looks at his buddy and says "I gotta go use the can." So he wonders off to the bathroom and... A horrible scream! Sound of shooting! His friend grabs his "kalashnikov" and rushes to the bathroom, where he sees his fellow reloading his gun with trembling hands, his face pale with fear. "What the hell happened?" The first drunk replies "Man, I dumped, but when I tried to flush, something reached up and grabbed my balls! Some mutant!!! So I jumped up and discharged the whole magazine at the toilet bowl!" The second drunk looks around and says "Well ya dumbass, you were sitting on the mop bucket!".
I would be terrified myself, if I were in his shoes! Ha-ha!

Swamp Doctor got called to examine the Freedom commander Lukash. After the examination the doctor said: "I can't find a cause for your illness. Frankly, I think it's due to drinking." "In that case," replied his high ranking patient, "I'll come back when you are sober."

A zombie falls down on a pile of construction rubble and gets its head torn off. The head rolls aside, sees the body roaming around to search for it and starts shouting: "I'm here! This way!" Then it stops screaming and murmurs sadly: "Why the hell am I shouting? The ears are on ME, actually..."

A veteran stalker got tired of rambling all over the Zone. So he decided to settle down in some abandoned house and make his living by farming. Once a rookie stalker comes to visit him and asks: "Haven't seen you in the Zone for a long time. Where have you been?" "I'm not going into the Zone ever again, I've got sick and tired of it. I'm satisfied with living here, farming and all... Come, take a look at my garden." The rookie takes a walk about the garden and gets excited! "Such big watermelons! Never saw anything like that! And the vegetable marrows are just wonderful! So nice here! And the nightingale sings so nicely! You've got an excellent garden!" The veteran sighs and says: "Just a garden, nothing special: those are not watermelons but gooseberries, not marrows but pea pods... And it's not a nightingale but a Geiger counter..."

A stalker comes to consciousness on a surgical table, sees a doctor and asks him: "Doctor! What's happened to me? I don't remember anything! Did I get into an anomaly?!" "That's right, into a "Whirligig", when approaching Yantar. We have found you and had to perform an urgent surgery..." "So, I am currently in Sakharov's bunker?" "Well... Mostly, my friend, MOSTLY..."

Monolith fanatics approach the Barrier. Freedom fighters keep getting prepared for the fight, when a voice comes on the radio: "Forsake the Barrier, infidels, and we let you leave in peace!" "In peace, you say?.. Hm... Do you need a drum, by the way?" "A drum?! To glorify the mighty Monolith?" "No. To take the lead of all those going to fuck themselves!"
Question. What do you call a Dutyer with an IQ of 160? \nAnswer: A quad.

One bandit says to his fellow : "Now, a good friend of mine, he knew the exact day of the year that he was going to die. It was the right year too. Not only that, but he knew what time he would die that day, and he was right about that too."\n Fellow: "Wow, that's Incredible. How did he know all of that?"\n Bandit : "The Duty commander, general Voronin, told him at court martial."
Yeah, amazing foresight, ha-ha!

A quad of Dutyers enters the bar. The guys have just come back from a deep raid against mutants, they are exhausted and hungry. So, they order meals and beer. While waiting for their order, they keep talking about how they wasted a controller, fought against hordes of zombies and bloodsuckers, etc. At that moment a mosquito flies into the room. All the Dutyers grab their weapons and open fire! Other visitors drop down to the floor in panic, the room fills up with smoke... After some time the Barkeep pokes his head from under the table: "Hey, hey!!! WTF?!?! What are you doing?!" The squad leader: "These bastards must be exterminated BEFORE they become mature bloodsuckers!"
Now I know where the bloodsuckers come from, ha-ha!
Did you know pseudogiants have their sex organs on their feet? They step on you and you're fucked!

A rookie stalker goes through the Zone and gets to a crossroad with a huge stone and a note on it: "Go left - get screwed, go right - get screwed, go forward - surely you get screwed!" So the rookie stops and starts thinking... After a couple of minutes a master stalker with a minigun comes out from behind the stone: "Hey, you! Choose quickly, or you get screwed right here!!!"

Once an old lone stalker came to the scientists' camp at Yantar. "I'm too old to hunt for swag, but I cannot leave the Zone - I've been here for so long that I've become a part of Her". The eggheads gladly accepted the lad, as they had a need for experienced stalkers, and he became a good adviser for them. One evening all the lab staff gathered at a get-together - chit-chat, food and drinks. And that stalker was there, too. The conversation finally got to an end (they started from the question of why there were no women in the Zone and ended up on the inability to distinguish a bloodsuckers' sex). They almost decided to wrap things up, when one of the young assistants addressed a question to the old stalker: "You've got experience, been through the whole Zone... Maybe you even saw the Monolith?" The old man hummed and hawed and finally said: "Well, I saw it." "What wish did you ask it to fulfill?" "Happiness", the old man said, "for all in general and for everybody in person." The scientists were listening attentively and questioning themselves: "How is it possible? The guy got granted a wish?! Is he joking?" The assistant let slip: "I wish we could see the Monolith, too..." "Why not? That's quite possible", the stalker hummed. He reached for his backpack and took out a handful of stones. The stones were obviously not ordinary, nothing anybody of those present had ever seen before. The scientists grasped the stones - curiosity was overwhelming them. And the stalker was watching them, saw their eyes glittering with delight and happiness... "Take them, have them, as many as you like... I've got plenty of this "happiness" in my backpack, for all in general and for everybody in person...", he kept muttering.

A stalker was passing through some swamp and saw an ordinary frog. He was taken aback at first, then he started looking for signs of mutation - a fifth extremity or an eye in the ass, whatever. But everything seemed to be normal. The stalker scratched his head and almost decided to leave, when the frog started speaking to him in human language: "Kiss me, my Prince, and I will become your Princess!" The guy hardly stopped himself from falling into the swamp! He collected his thoughts and started crouching backwards away from the frog. And the latter spoke again: "Come on, kiss me! I'll turn into a beautiful princess and we'll live happily together ever after!" The stalker finally thought: "Who knows what kind of miracles may happen in the Zone? May it be true? Why not, maybe it really turns into a beauty?!" So he finally kissed the frog. Immediately after the kiss, the frog became covered in thick smoke, and when the smoke vanished... There was a bloodsucker! "Thank you, my Prince! A deal is a deal, and from now on I will be your Princess! And don't you ever dare say I'm not a beauty!!!"

One stalker has finally managed to reach the Monolith. So there he stands, almost glowing from the rads, half-dead, thinking out a wish. And that's what he asked for: "I want to piss vodka!" 
Boom! He takes a glass, takes a leak and drinks - perfect vodka! So, he easily gets rid of the radiation, gets himself proper drunk and goes back to the camp. In the camp he goes directly to Sidorovich's bunker, fills another glass and hands it to the trader. 
"Drink it!" 
"Are you nuts?!", exclaimed Sidorovich. "Cool, man, smell it!.." 
The whole day everybody in the camp is as pissed as a newt with "Stalker's vodka". The morning after, Sidorovich wakes up suffering from severe hangover and asks the stalker for another glass for his bad head. And the stalker tells him, 
"No, Sidorovich, it's payback time. How you treated me, is the same way I will treat you! Yesterday was just a free sample, but today... for money and straight from the 'bottle', you old profiteer!"

Sidorovich has found some rookie stalker, and gave him an offer. "Listen, sonny, I was given a new suit from the Kiev Research Institute. They wanted me to test it. It is supposed to protect fully from radiation, 100%. But I am an old man, all I can manage is to sit here all day. Why don't you take it, test it for several days, and then come and report to me. I can give you a discount on this one, let's say, half the price." The rookie took the suit and went out. Several days have passed. One morning, the rookie enters Sidorovich's bunker, angry as a snork, and throws the suit on the table in front of the trader. Sidorovich looks at him in surprise. "So?! How did it work?" "I don't want this crap." "But why? Isn't it protecting?" "Yes, you can bet it is." "Completely?! 100%?!" "Yes, 100%." "So what's wrong then?" "You know how the whole Zone treats radiation exposure with vodka? Now, because of this suit of yours, I'VE BEEN SOBER FOR 4 DAYS ALREADY!!!!!"

A stalker wakes up in a luxurious villa. He looks around and sees a gorgeous naked blonde beside him and a couple of gentlemen in tuxedos playing cards at a table and chattering quietly. The stalker asks them, "Who are you, guys?" 
"We are zombies." 
"How come???!!!" 
"Don't you remember? You and Sidorovich got drunk yesterday, reached for the Monolith and started making wishes. First, you wanted to play poker and were lacking two players. It was then that you saw us. Second, it started raining, and Sidorovich wished for a house. After that you... Eh... How do I put it..." 
"I did what? WTF?! And where's Sidorovich?" 
Immediately the blonde opens her eyes and speaks in a husky bass, "GOT THE LOOT?"

An advertisement on the door to Sidorovich's bunker: "Don't miss the new deal! Buy 2 "kalashnikovs", 800 "fivers", 3 Makarov pistols with 6 loaded magazines for them, 12 antirads (or 16 bottles of vodka), 18 medkits and 7 grenades - and get A BANDAGE FOR FREE!!!"

Two stalkers are sitting by the campfire. One of them is strumming on his guitar and singing: "Damnnnn! Damnnnn!" One hour passes like that... "Damnnnn! Damnnn!" for another hour... Suddenly his companion says: "Man! You must write down the song! It's so heart touching!.."

Late night in the Bar. A drunk stalker lifts his head from the table, staggers to another stalker by the bar and asks if he could buy him a drink. "Why of course," comes the reply. The first stalker then asks: "Where are you from?" "I'm from Moldova", replies the second stalker. The first guy responds: "You don't say, I'm from Moldova too! Let's have another round to Moldova." "Of course," replies the second man. Curious, the first stalker then asks: "Where in Moldova are you from?" "Chishinau," comes the reply. "I can't believe it," says the first man. "I'm from Chishinau too! Let's have another drink to Chishinau." "Of course," replies the second stalker. Curiosity again strikes and the first lad asks: "What school did you go to?" "Number #1," replies the second fellow, "I graduated in '97." "This is unbelievable!", the first man says. "I went to school number #1 and I graduated in '97, too!" About that time in comes one of the Dutyers and sits down at the bar. "What's been going on?" he asks Barkeep. "Nothing much," replies the bartender. "The Popescu twins are drunk again."

Sidorovich: "Ah... It's you, Vasyok... What have you got this time?" "Just a bit of everything..." - said the bloodsucker and tripped out on the table a bunch of rifles and some outfits with blood stains on them...

An advertisement on the door to Sidorovich's bunker: "Don't miss out! The "Burner" competition!!! Pass through a "Burner", consider yourself an experienced stalker. Discounts for those suffering from burns are guaranteed."

A stalker was staggering to the camp from a raid to the Garbage. Bad luck for him that day! The only loot he had found was a bottle of vodka. Not even the cheapest artifact! Nothing at all, but this bottle of vodka in his backpack. Occupied with his sad thoughts he did not notice the "Springboard", which tossed him backwards and he fell heavily. Struggling to his feet, he felt something wet running down his leg. "Please, God," he implored, "let it be blood!"

A zombie rambles about the Zone and sees an artifact. He grabs it and continues to stagger aimlessly. At that moment a stalker catches up with the zombie, his cheeks hollow, outfit torn, eyes red... A pitiful sight, in a nutshell. So, the stalker says: 
"Zombie, be so kind, give me the artifact! I've been after it for 10 days, ran out of food and ammo... Please! Will ya?" 
"Hell, no. I found it! It's mine!" 
But the stalker keeps begging him, so finally, the zombie thinks a while and tells him: 
"Ok, lets make a test. Whoever kicks his opponent's balls harder, wins and gets the artifact. But I will be the first to kick!" 
The stalker thought a while and agreed. The zombie takes a run and performs a forceful blow! The guy almost pukes his balls and falls down! Finally, he comes to himself and tells the zombie: 
"Ok, now it's my turn." 
"No. You may have the artifact - I don't need it anyway."

In a period of truce between Duty and Freedom, two militants of these factions get into an argument. The Dutyer keeps shouting that mutants must be exterminated, while the Freedomer says they have the right to live and some of them are even like humans. The Dutyer gets pissed and tries to prove they aren't: 
"Mutants can't talk!" 
"Zombies can." 
"They cannot express feelings!" 
"Controllers can." 
"They can not love!" 
"They've got a similar feeling. They take care of others of their kind." 
"They... they... they can not stutter!" 
The Freedomer thinks a while, then says: 
"Sure they do! I was at the Garbage the other day to get some weed from a supplier, and there was a cat nearby. After some time a pack of blind dogs came, and the cat went "ffffffff! ffffffffff! fffffffff!", and before he could say "FUCK OFF!", the dogs ate him!"

A controller got bored of life. Playing with the minds of soldiers at Agroprom was no longer interesting - they had nothing in their heads other than thoughts of girls and demobilization. Veteran stalkers were no better - their minds were usually completely dulled with the vodka they drink to combat radiation... Rookies were too afraid to enter the tunnels - so their minds were not within reach... Life became so damn boring! So the controller went to Sidorovich to seek advice. Sidorovich stared at him with his lackluster eyes, hiccuped, took another gulp from the bottle and said: "You are too scary! Change your public image! Put some foolish cap on, apply some make-up, learn to smile, for example... Use your abilities for something else, stop scaring people..." Not long after that the famous clown Yuri Kuklachev made his first debut with his band of trained cats...

Sidorovich tells his bodyguard: "I'm going to bed now, but make sure you wake me up when I want to drink some vodka." "How will I know exactly the moment you want to drink?" "Just wake me up and then it will come."

Have you heard how the guys taught Mitka Squint-eyed a good lesson? You haven't?! Listen, then. That's the best story ever! Even Wolf himself was among them. Nothing too brutal, don't worry. Ok, I'll try to make it short. So, when he was still a newbie, Mitka was carrying himself in a very haughty manner. Kept wrangling with the veterans, like he knew everything and was a master of all skills. And there was another bad habit about him - he was fond of playing jokes on fellow stalkers. Tying a knot on shoelaces while someone is asleep and all that schoolboy crap. They even thought of giving him the nickname "King", but had enough sense to give up the idea - the guy would've become even more arrogant. What was I was coming to?.. Ah, got it. So, everybody became tired of him and they decided to give him a good lesson. They solicited some sticky tape from Sidorovich, found a bucket and a stick. The bucket was placed on Mitka's head, and the stick was placed in his hands and fixed with the tape. When everything was ready, Wolf started drumming on the bucket and screaming: "King Arthur! Wake up! We've been attacked!" That was something, you know! Half-awake Mitka jumped up on his double bed and hit the ceiling with his head in the bucket! When he tried to take the bucket off, he got it hit a couple of times again with the stick in his hands!.. Uff... What happened after that? Well, they untied him, of course... He was in a huff with the guys for a couple of days, but later on he became mild as a lamb. He's now one of the veterans... That's it...

Have you heard the story of what happened to Chef recently? You know, The Chef! The one from the Freedom, at the Army Warehouses. So, listen. That's how he told it: "One nice evening I went out of our base to take a look around for some artifacts or whatever, just to get myself enough for a drink. So, I keep walking, touching nothing and there I see it! A cat with a cigarette in its mouth! Looking like it was about to light up and have a smoke! The first thought was that I have finally drank my mind into oblivion! Besides, the Brain Scorcher is not far from there, so you know... Ok, so I rubbed my eyes for a bit, hoping that the hallucination would disappear. Nothing of the sort! And the cat started approaching me! I couldn't think of anything better than to take to my heels and run back to the base. Now, I'm no rookie, seen plenty in the Zone, but that was just too fucked up even for me! The guys from our lot didn't believe me at first. But later on one of our groups came back from the Barrier. They finally shed some light on the incident. It turned out that there was a vial with valerian drops among the ordinary medicine, and one of the lads found it and went off to the Barrier with his group. When on his way, he spilt a few drops and saw local cats gathering in that place. The damn humorist decided to make a joke and spilt some more drops on a cigarette... And the cat got it..." That's it, Marked one. There's something familiar that still remains in these Zone cats, something reminiscent of our ordinary house cats...

Well, how about a real story. 
A group of scientists was out for some field research at Yantar, and they had a squad of Duty as their security. Bad luck for them - they came across a horde of zombies and had to seek cover in some tunnel or something. So, the Duty guards were holding ground on both sides. The eggheads were good for nothing, except for one young assistant, a newbie in the Zone. Although pale and trembling with fear, he started reloading magazines for the Duty soldiers. Just to cheer the lad up, the squad sergeant asked him, "Scared, know-it-all?". 
"No", he replied, "just a bit apprehensive." 
"What's the difference??!", the commander wondered. Guess what was his answer? 
"That means I'm scared with a university education." 
Just imagine! This is the lad's first time out of his home town, He's been weaned from his mother and sent straight into the Zone, and now attacked by zombies! And yet he's just "apprehensive"! Attaboy!

Wait a minute, I'll tell you a story. One day I got some artifacts at the Garbage and went back to Cordon to sell them to Sidorovich and get myself some equipment for deeper raids. That's not the point, though. So, while walking on the road from Garbage to Cordon, I suddenly got a feeling that something was wrong. Something was holding me back from making a step forward! It was like an indicator flicking in my head: "Attention! Attention! Danger!", my hairs stood on end, never felt anything like this before. While I was standing there all freaked out, a stalker, probably a rookie, was coming towards me along the road. As he came nearer, a few meters away, he took a step over some invisible field or barrier and something happened to him... He got... How can I describe it adequately... It's like he got torn inside out!!! Without a single sound, not a noise or a peep or a scream! Just the ribcage splitting open like a venus fly trap, internal organs and blood flying all over the place, limbs broken and deformed... I- I kept drowning out that memory in drink for about a week straight after that... I guess what I'm getting at here, is... Just take care of yourself, Marked One. Learn to trust your senses...

Well, I've got a remarkable story: 
One evening my buddies and myself were sitting by a campfire out in the Zone. Just trying to have some fun, you know; - vodka, jokes, snacks, trying to unwind from the stress. Once we got a few drinks in, one of the lads went off a distance to take a shit. Then suddenly out of nowhere... Screaming, shooting, chaos! 
Within seconds the guy made it back to us, trembling in fear and with his trousers still down by his knees. "What happened?!" we asked him. 
"I sat down by some bush to dump, and suddenly something hit me on the ass!! So, I took to my feet, shooting back and shitting all over the place..." 
Man, we almost laughed our heads off! Anyway, we decided to go and check out the place, see what kind of pervert attacked our friend. Once we approached these bushes and lit them up with the flashlights... Only that dumbass shitter remained standing, the rest of us were on the floor, pissing ourselves laughing: laying down beneath the bush was a zombie with shit all over his face!!! 
The poor creature was just laying there while our buddy was taking a dump on his face! Obviously, as the zombie had been trying to wave away the stinky bastard, it slapped our buddy on the ass... 
Once we composed ourselves, we went and put the bastard out of his misery, not even a zombie deserves a "shitty" fate like that! Ha-ha... Man, this story has stayed with me since then, probably the best thing I've seen out here! Everytime I feel down, I just remember that zombie's shit stained expression and I start chuckling to myself!

Have you heard what happened to Chef recently? That one stalker, the one from the Freedom, at the Army Warehouses. So, listen, this is how it went. One evening he went out on a raid for some artifacts, just on his lonesome to earn some drinking cash. As he kept pushing deeper into the wilderness, he saw something that made him stop and rub his eyes! There was a mutant cat sitting around with a fucking cigarette in his mouth! The cat was just chilling out in the weeds, smoking a fag! The guy thought that maybe he was going nuts or that he walked too close to the barrier and his brain was slowly frying... No matter how hard he tried, he could not make it go away, the cat was real, not just a figment of his imagination. Then, the fucking cat gets up and starts approaching him, all casual like! The guy freaks out and starts legging it full speed ahead back to the Freedom base. Stop laughing, this is a serious story! You may think he was probably high since the Freedom guys like to dabble in that stuff but listen to the rest, it gets better! The fellas back at the Freedom base did not believe a word he said. They all thought he was tripping on some bad 'shrooms until a squad came back from the Scorcher. Upon hearing the story, they roared in laughter and explained the whole thing. Turns out, one of those guys had some LSD in liquid form that he liked to take from time to time, for the experience, and he spilled some on the ground closer to the barrier. Later on he saw a few local cats gathering in that place, lapping that shit right off the ground. The damn bastard decided to have some fun and spilt some more drops on a cigarette, then he threw it at the cats... And one of the bastard cats caught it... So, the hero of our story wasn't hallucinating at all, strange things really do happen in the Zone! Just imagine what that cat must have been seeing, though, tripped up on acid like that! This whole story is just beyond bizarre, hanging out with Freedom is a real trip!

Once a young assistant got assigned to that field lab at Yantar. This kid was different from the others, usually the eggheads over there are smart and prefer to listen attentively before talking, but this dick had read so many science papers back at the institute that he thought himself wiser than all the other professors. He believed he was the smartest brainiac in the whole lab, started throwing his weight around, giving commands to the others... They mostly shrugged it off and ignored him, let the fool get it out of his system... But the guy would not relent, he was really eager to prove himself and get recognized! So he tried to impress everybody with his knowledge of the Zone, the mutants, the stalkers and their traditions, everything! Even Sakharov got tired of the upstart! \nOne day a group of experienced stalkers dropped by at the lab to trade in some goods, and this prick got right in the middle of them and started proclaiming wise scientific terms and theories on how to tell a Chernobyl dog from its phantom, how to catch a controller alive, bla-bla-bla. At that moment Sakharov entered the chamber and stopped for a while to listen. Then he addressed himself to the pipsqueak, "You have been revealing remarkable things to us about the Zone's mysteries and elusive mutant behavioral patterns. I have got a question I need help with. A flesh, a rodent and a pseudodog all eat the same meat. Yet a rodent excretes it in little pellets, while a flesh's excretion is a flat patty and a pseudodog produces thick clumps of fecal mass. Why is that so?". "Well... I don't know", the assistant answered. So Sakharov continued: \n"How is it, then, that you, young man, feel qualified to teach experienced stalkers survival in the Zone when YOU DON'T KNOW SHIT?!!"

This one Duty squad happened to find out about a secret ammo storehouse used by mercenaries in the vicinity of the "Rostok" factory. So, they decided to raid this storehouse, taking all the gear for themselves and depriving the mercs of valuable supplies, with the intention of thinning their presence in the area. The next day General Voronin was woken up by some commotion taking place out on the front yard. He went out and saw Petrenko giving two Duty men a dressing-down. "Colonel, it's early morning! Why do you shout at these soldiers? They took part in yesterday's operation, they are tired and exhausted. One was even wounded, as far as I see... Why do you lecture them?" 
"Greeting, General! Better ask these two idiots yourself, if you please." 
"Well, boys, spit it out, what happened?" 
"Nothing much... Our squad got to the objective yesterday just as ordered. When the signal to attack was issued, we approached the hangar in which the ammo storehouse was supposed to be located... There we noticed some mercs, but their behavior was abnormal - they were somewhat doltish. It was obviously a controller's influence. We managed to annihilate the mercs silently and started scanning the area to locate the mutant. Both of us entered the hangar and noticed a shadow slip through one of the rooms. We looked inside, but it was too dark. Once we turned on our flashlights, we saw that the room was filled with containers and crates and whatever was in there had plenty of cover. So Fedka suggested, "Let's throw a grenade there! Either it will kill the bastard outright or it will demolish the crates so that we can see the controller." And so we did... 
"And what happened next? Did you manage to see it?" 
At this moment Petrenko couldn't restrain himself anymore, and shouted, "Half of the Zone managed to see it!!! These damned saboteurs went and detonated the entire ammo storehouse!!!
Lukash stands by a mirror and keeps murmuring something to himself with his hands covering his shoulder straps: "Now - a stupid bastard..." Uncovering the straps: "and now - a senior lieutenant..."

Barkeep tells a stalker: "Here, take this brick and bring down a military helicopter." "???!!! With a BRICK?!?!?!" "You are a stalker, aren't you?" "I am a REAL stalker!!! I'll bring down two helicopters!!!!!" And he proceeds to break the brick in two halves.

It's not clothes that make the man, out here it is only the man that makes the difference, his clothes be damned. The Zone ain't a bar with a backroom brothel and cheap whores, nor is it a kindergarten. See what I'm getting at here? Ya can get yourself some pro gear and a cool shooter, have money to burn and swim in artifacts, but if yer head is full of shit and you get caught with your hands in your pockets, you'll get wasted just like that! No second chances for ya, one mistake is all you get! I'm telling ya, be attentive! Pay attention! Eyes peeled at all times! Otherwise you'll end up just like Vitka Nosy. I told him hundreds o'times, "Don't walk by these gaps, don't go over there!" He wouldn't listen! Now we can't even find his body. Just got a message on the PDA:\n- Stalker died: Vitka Nosy. Cause of death: unknown... -
Can you help me get in touch with the Dark Valley crew?

No problem. You helped me out - So I'll help you. I'm gonna need one grand to grease some palms. I'll make a deal with the family so that they know to let you through, don't take too long though or they'll just forget about it.
Alright. Here's the money.
I've changed my mind.
Sidorovich, I've had it with these mobsters. What would you say if I wanted to hop the fence, make nice with the loners again? Can you vouch for me?

Well now, what's the matter? Life of a bandit a little tougher than you expected so you come crawling back with your tail between your legs like a beaten dog, eh?... Look, Marked One, you are a capable guy so I can handle this matter for you because we need guys like you, doesn't mean I have to like it. As restitution for the damages you may have caused and for your error in judgment, I'm gonna have to charge you a fat lump of cash, consider it your repentance. Pay me 40 thousand rubles and I'll let everyone know you're one of us again. Don't mess it up, my reputation is at stake here!
Alright, deal.
No, thanks, I've changed my mind.
Listen, I've got some friction with the loners. Can you act on my behalf to work out a truce?

Yeah, I heard about your little adventures out there, shouldn't be too difficult to set things right. Besides, you haven't made them too crazy about it, just a little misunderstanding, shit happens. I'm gonna need an up front fee, say, 10 thousand rubles - and I'll set it ok. I'll bring in the offended parties, give them a discount and they'll play along.

Yeah, you've managed to piss off quite a few of the stalkers around here, better fix your act now or they'll get together and put you out of your misery while you sleep. I won't always be around to cover for you and it's a ruthless world out there, the stalkers have a way of cleaning out the bad apples, know what I mean? Remember, Marked One, that trust and reputation are often the only things a stalker can rely on to survive in the Zone and you're throwing both away... Now then, I'll try to salvage your reputation, but you'll have to earn back their trust. Give me 20 grand and you can sleep peacefully tonight, as all your sins are washed away, he-he-he...

Well... I was wondering when you'd come in to talk about this... Man, I don't know what you did out there, but you really pissed off the stalkers. I've heard so many stories about the fucked up shit you've been doing that I no longer know which of them is true and which of them was the result of a campfire horror story. One thing I do know, however, is that the veterans are organizing a posse of sorts to take you out. You've been bad for business, put a lot of good men into the dirt and caused a lot of instability to the area, and the veterans don't like upstarts and troublemakers of any kind. They're no doubt planning to get you alive so that they can teach you a lesson first, a little bit of torture perhaps, or maybe they'll just throw you legs first into an acid anomaly, don't know what's worse... Ok, let's cut to the chase. I'm glad you came to me, I know you can be rough around the edges but you're a skilled worker and I can't afford to throw you to the wolves just yet. Hand over 30 thousand and you let me handle those veterans, nothing cheers a man up more than free vodka and ammo, maybe we can play nice and force them to put aside their grand ideas of revenge. Don't push it though, you're gonna have to earn your place among them, don't expect them to just forget what you've done.

Ah, in walks the devil himself. Marked One, I did not save you from that Death Truck and nurture you back to health only for you to turn feral and eliminate all my potential customers! I don't know what kind of problems you have with the loners but I suggest you put it aside because you're seriously pissing all over my business here! Ok, you want me to fix things up? You'll have to pay up! For all the losses you've cost me, you'll have to hand over 40k and I'll try to put things right, no guarantees though. Now, get out of here and lay low until I fix your mess.

You've stirred up a regular hornets nest, I don't think we've ever had a bastard quite like you wandering around the Zone! I have half a mind to just have your throat cut and have your carcass dumped over in the anomaly pit... I won't be fishing anymore stalkers out of Death Trucks, that's for certain, you guys must be cursed or something! If you want me to try to fix up this carnage you caused, it's gonna be tough, almost impossible, in fact. These rookies out there are more afraid of you than they are of bloodsuckers, even the experienced stalkers always keep on guard and tense up at the mere mention of your name. You are a black omen, just a pure psychopath, and I for one won't really care much if some stalkers group up to have you killed. I suggest you keep your distance from any loner camps for a while... You want my help? Fine, but it's gonna cost you 50 grand as payment for the damage you caused.

Look who it is, in walks Hitler's incarnate, the Zone's own fucking death machine! How many stalkers have you wasted so far today, you stupid psychopath? I should have you put down like a rabid dog, give me one good reason why I should let you leave this bunker alive?? Killing you would be so good for business, all the stalkers around would party all night, and I'd get to sell a shit ton of booze. After all your mess, you think you get to just walk in here and ask me to put things right?! How exactly do you expect me to do that?? Only solution I see is to put a bullet in your skull! Fuck, I need a drink... Okay, Marked One, you reached out, you came to me, I respect that you had guts to walk right into the camp here to talk peace. I'll throw you a bone and give you a chance to pay me back for the hardships you caused to my establishment. Hand over 60 thousand rubles, and I'll work on trying to make this carnage look like somebody else's work, a stolen PDA, some type of merc frame job, whatever... Give me time to think, meanwhile go hide yourself and don't show your face back here for a while!
I'm up for it. I can afford that.
Ok. Here's hoping the loners take it easy from now on.
Deal. Here's hoping I don't get killed on sight.
That's a deal. Hope the conflict will be resolved.
Alright. Less fighting means less trouble.
Screw you, greedy bastard! I'll be just fine without your intervention.
The Wild Territory. A hole in the bushes. Ok, I'll try to find it. Thanks!
Don't forget about the stashed weapon. The shotgun is hidden in the Wild Territory. The place is near a bush.
Thanks, I'll keep that in mind.
You wanted to ask about something, didn't you?
I do remember, but I haven't got it yet. Quite hard to come by one nowadays.
How is it going? Remember my request? Have you got a bottle for me?
Here you are! Your elixir, heh!

Thanks, Marked One. It's twice now you've saved my ass and helped me out greatly. Look, I've got this secret stash in the Wild Territory, consider it yours. After one of the blowouts, space shifted near some bushes out there and I discovered a new path. Once you find this bush, follow the path to the gates of a workshop. I've hidden a remarkable weapon there near the hole by the gates - a modified sighted shotgun with some spare shells. I know it's far but I have no doubt you'll make it out there eventually, so once you do make it, the weapon is yours. But be careful on your way out of there! The path back to the main territory is rather dangerous.
What are you muttering? C'mon, speak up!
Look, Marked One. I'm damn stressed after all this shit that happened, can barely sleep. Can you help me, please?
What do you want from me?

I need a little something to help me forget my troubles. Get a bottle of vodka for me. Don't worry, I've got something to pay you back with - you won't regret it, I assure you. Stop laughing, man, I'm not a pisshead, I just want to get wasted and pass out for the next few hours! I'm dead serious, I'm offering a big reward for a mere bottle of booze, a really good deal and I'm offering it to you because you helped me out earlier! So, bring me a bottle fast and I'll give you something interesting!
Ok, no problem. Deal.
No, I don't feel like searching for vodka right now.
This area is off limits, stalker.
But I need to go there.
Tough luck. Unless you REALLY need to go, then the price is 4000.
Here you are.
Now listen up. We'll pretend for a moment it's nothing but mosquitoes and butterflies around here. What happens beyond this point is your own damn business.
Alright, keep moving! Get your ass outta here, before we change our mind.
I don't have that kind of money.
Then go back where you came from and get it. And don't you try and sneak past us, you hear? Trust me, it's not worth dying for.
Get out of here, Marked One. Walk away or crawl away, the choice is yours.
What's got into you?
Hi there. Whatcha need?
Our boss here wanted to see you. But that doesn't make you a welcome guest. Keep moving.
Hello, brother.
Guide, I need to see Doctor.
Well, look at that. How do you know about Doctor?
Ghost sent me. Help me get in touch with Doctor. It's urgent.
Well, why didn't you say so! Doctor is in Strelok's hiding place. If you are who you say you are, you probably know where it is.
Thank you.
Hello, brother.
Could you tell me more about this place?

This is the road to the Zone. If I were you, I wouldn't get too close to the army outpost or let those soldiers see you - they've got orders to shoot on sight. Further up North there's a broken bridge, but they've set up an outpost there too. Open areas are crawling with wild dogs, so it's not a safe place for rookies. Oh, and a pack of bandits shows up every now and then.
What about the soldiers at the bridge? I've got to get past them somehow.

Alright, you've got two options. If Kuznetsov is on duty, keep in mind that he is quite fond of money. Good chance he'll let you through for a bribe. But if you're low on cash or if it's someone else's shift, there is a different way. Go to the left side of the bridge, along the railway. Just make sure they don't see you! You'll come across a small tunnel that goes through the embankment. It's dangerous though, there's some type of an electrical anomaly down there that'll fry you in an instant if you get caught in it. And another thing: you might also land a date with some zombies down there.
What's further up North beyond the army outpost?

The Garbage, that�s what. Now there's a depressing place. So much contaminated shit in some spots that swimming would be easier than walking. I really wouldn't recommend wading through it, unless you want your piss to start glowing brighter than your flashlight.
Hello. Wolf has already sent word of you. You got any questions?
Yes. How many bandits in the camp?

Seven or eight people. Two by the gate, two more in the building to the right near the fire, and another two in the one to the left - that's where they're keeping Nimble. Someone usually hangs around the yard as well. That's about it. Shall we say a prayer and go?
Let's go. Round up your men.
No. We'd make too much noise. I'll go on my own.
Well, do as you please. Here, take this PB. Might as well try to do it quietly. Shout if something is up... Good luck, Rambo wannabe!
We went hunting and hunt we did. I bet Wolf will be pleased.
There's more of 'em! Find the bastards and take them down!
Whoa, man! Now that was something! You wiped them out and left nothing for us. I'd never believe it if I hadn't seen it with my own eyes! That blew me away, man...
So, where are the piles of all these enemies you killed? You talk the talk, but you don't walk the walk. Get lost!
Sorry, brother, but could you go somewhere else? I'm not in a chatty mood right now...
I've got a couple of questions.
OK, ask away.
What can you tell me about the Zone?

That's all you wanna know? Take a week off and then come back to see me. Look, my time ain't cheap and I'm kinda busy right now. Here are the basics and then you're on your own. About three kilometers North of here, you'll find the Garbage. That's the place where they used to dump all the radioactive waste from the station. High radiation levels, anomalies all over the place, so there are loads of artifacts to be found there... but not very valuable. Just beware of the gangs and don't cross the Duty patrols. West of the Garbage is the former Agroprom Research Institute. Little in terms of artifacts there so you can skip it. And to the East, there's the Dark Valley. Who knows... That's a pretty weird place. It seems quiet enough, apart from a bunch of gangsters roaming around. But I got a feeling there's more to it than meets the eye. Oh, and there's the Rostok factory right beyond the Garbage. That's Duty territory and a popular stalker hideout. You'll find lots of clued-up folks there, they'll tell you the rest.
I've changed my mind. Thanks.
Thanks. OK, now I'm listening very carefully.
Trader told me you might know something about Strelok.

Why is everyone taking such a keen interest in him lately? OK, I can't say I know him personally. We did "communicate" though: my guys took some shots at him once. No one got hurt - it was clear his party had been waiting for someone else, so we parted in peace. Cussed each other out across a ravine and went on our separate ways. Seriy, my brother, is now in the hangar at the Garbage - I'll dish you his coordinates so you two can have a chat. He knows more about Strelok. Be careful at the exit, a small gang has settled down in those parts. By the way, I got a few mutts chasing me and it doesn't look like they've given up yet. You mind helping me deal with them? It's a walk in the park really.
Thanks for the info, I appreciate it.
A medkit! Gimme a medkit!
Here you are.
Don't have one. Sorry.
Hey, man, you saved me twice, and that's not something I forget. Take this... that's all I got!
Thank you.
Our boss here wanted to see you. But that doesn't make you a welcomed guest. Keep moving.
Wait, Marked One! No one at the camp is gonna to talk to you right now.
Why?
What kind of idiot would chat with a former passenger of the "death truck"? First, you gotta prove you're OK to deal with.
What "death truck?" What are you talking about?

Ah, hell only knows what it really is. But whatever it is, it's bad, about as bad as it gets... Why am I talking to you about this anyway?! Maybe I'm just superstitious, but you, Marked One, should really take a hike before something happens to you. Go speak to the Trader, prove that you can be trusted, then we'll see.
What can I do to make people believe me?
Talk to the Trader, do some work around here while we watch. If you're alright - if you're not trigger-happy and you use your head - then we'll definitely find some common ground. Don't you worry.
Alright, so be it.
Hello, Marked One. What do you want?
Listen up, Marked One, you will come in handy! We could really use some help.
Go on.

I'm Fanatic, and I'm filling in as the leader around here since Wolf left. A few Mercs came by here yesterday... and they were some tough bastards, let me tell you. They come here and start making serious demands - "You've got one day to clear this camp out. It's gonna be our new base." Tonight they're coming back, and as you can imagine, they won't be in the mood for a chat.
So, what are you going to do?

We're gonna set up an ambush 'cause a direct attack would probably be the end of us. They've got the fighting gear and everything, plus they're trained in tactics like you can't even imagine. And all we've got here are little boys. So, we've decided to just sit tight in these houses and make it look like we're gone. Then when the right moment comes, we attack. Fighters like you are just the thing we could use right now. And we'd make sure to thank you properly after it's all over. You know we're good for it! So, what do you say, will you help us out?
I will.

Let's spend the rest of the time preparing for the fight. Here's the plan: I'll put the most hopeless rookies in houses and basements and tell them not to make a move - otherwise they'll just get in the way and might even slaughter each other by accident. You and me and a couple other decent shots will take the best positions to have an eye on the area around the fire. As soon as they come close to the fire, we let the bullets fly from everywhere! They'll be coming from the bridge... and I don't think we'll have to wait long. So, find yourself a hiding place with a view, then wait for my command. Take a look around, but remember that your odds aren't as good in the open. It's your call.
OK.
No, I'm not ready yet.
That's a shame. We could really use a fighter like you. I guess we'll have to do it on our own...
Waiting for these boy scouts. I got a feeling they're just around the corner.
You're a real killer, Marked One! I wouldn't want to stand in your way. Ever!
Yup, something like that.
Here, I hope you won't forget about us. And by the way... a million thanks for the help. We saved the young ones, Marked One.
Hey, Marked One, great to see you!
Hello to you, too.
By the way, where did Wolf go?

Oh, he got a message from a stalker who was passing by. He packed his things, grabbed a box of dynamite and went deep in the Zone. I came to the Cordon to rest up and recover from some bad wounds so he asked me to look after the kids.
Wow! Look who it is! Wolf! What brings you up here?!

My old good fellow, Skull, asked for help. He used to be in Duty but got into a quarrel with his seniors, or something like that. He's going to put an end to those anarchists, but he lacks ammunition and equipment for that. So, he asked me to help him out of friendship and bring him some explosives. Well, so happened I had a stash of dynamite on hand so I agreed to deliver it, the very same crate I asked you to fetch for me. Besides, I was getting real bored of the quiet life at the Cordon after you cleaned the area up so I welcomed the opportunity to do another deep raid into the Zone, see my old pals, maybe pick up some loot. I left the rookies in capable hands, a friend of mine called Fanatic came down to stay for a while so I asked him to keep an eye on the camp.
I see. So, I wonder, why does your buddy need dynamite?

Haven't got the slightest idea. He's become very strange recently, getting real pissed off with those Freedom stoners. I'm kinda afraid he'll just get himself and his men killed for nothing... His lads will follow him to the grave, they obey every order he gives, even if it doesn't make much sense.
Sounds like something personal...
That's right. Listen, Marked One, if you meet Skull some day - better stay away from him just to be safe.
Ok, thanks for the advice.
I've got questions.
Go ahead, I'll try to help.
Thank you.
What do you know about the Zone?
I know many things. Be more specific.
What's in the center of the Zone?

Ahem, that's a question alright... I've been looking for the answer for two years! I still haven't found a way to the center, at least not one I could take and come back alive. My friends and I tried to break through a couple of times. I barely made it back, but my friends - well, some did, some didn't... You'll ask why we went there at all. We were chasing our dreams, trying to make them come true.
Can dreams come true?

There is this beautiful story about a Wish-Granting Machine. They say there is a spot in the center of the Zone where any desires can come true, no matter how bizarre. But you know what? I know for a fact there's lots of ways to kick the bucket in the center of the Zone, and I don't believe in the Wish-Granting Machine anymore. Don't take that risk. I wouldn't.
How did the Zone come to be?
There was another explosion here in 2006. That's how it came about. I know that's not a real answer. Very few know the whole truth, if anyone at all.
What brought you to the Zone?

I used to work in a mine before they closed it down. I had no money and nothing to look forward to. Then I heard some rumors about the fabulous riches hidden inside the Zone. I had some experience under my belt, so I thought "What the hell not?". Can't say I've become rich, but some cash came my way, that's for sure. Not a really interesting story; most of us got here the same way.
What's the most dangerous thing in the Zone?

Hard to say. There are so many dangers and surprises, you just can't run into all of them. There's more than enough for one person anyway. I got one toe bitten off, my hair is falling out from the radiation, and half my leg got fried in a Scorcher... Things are real bad out there. Another time I happened to come face to face with a bloodsucker - now there's a meeting I'd like to forget. So, we can talk all you like, but you'll never truly know until you experience it on your own. The only advice I can give is to be on your guard - everywhere and always.
Have you heard about a guy called Strelok?

I seem to remember he's one of the tough ones. Never actually met the man. Well, I haven't come close to the center in a while and all we get here is rookies. You should find someone who hangs out deep in the Zone and have a chat with him.
What do you know about "death trucks?"

I know nothing and that's fine by me, thank you! Sorry, I know about your situation. Too much mysticism about it. You spend a month in these parts and you can't help but become superstitious about life. Dead people in the trunk, dead people behind the wheel... Who are they, where did they come from and why? I can only hope they didn't rise up from the grave.
Hi. Why are you here?
Hi. I need to find Nimble. Would you happen to know where I could start searching?

Nimble got a raw deal. His group was attacked by some bandits a little ways from here. All he could do was send me an SOS message. It looked like his pals went under. My guys told me these bastards are now at the old car park, the one across the road.
You don't rescue your own people from prison? Not what I would call friendly. Or is it that you're just too weak to do it?

I'd bop you one, but what's the use? It's not that simple. I got too few people, and even those I got are mostly rookies. I can't take that risk. If we lose this camp, things will get even worse for all the stalkers out there. And what about yourself? If you aren't too scared, I won't let my pride make me say no to a helping hand. So, will you help me deal with these thugs?
Think I could do it alone?
Nah, you stand no chance on your own. My scouts are good soldiers and right now they're right behind those freaks. Together you can make a run for it. What do you think? You got the guts?
I'll try.
Attaboy! Wait a minute, don't be in a rush. There's one more thing for you. Do me a personal favor.
Spit it out. What kind of favor?

I've got a request for a... a delivery of explosives. I wish I could say more but it's better if I don't. Anyway, that's not important, what's important is that you'll be rewarded. There is a crate of dynamite stashed at the car factory you are heading to now, so might as well grab it once you're there and lug it back here. Once you deal with the bandits, just look around for it, should be stashed inside of a container. Are you up for it? Easy money, my friend, you can hit two birds with one stone and get double the pay. Also, listen, it's unlikely, but in case you can't find me or something happens, just try to get this crate to the army warehouses, someone will meet you.
Deal, then. I'll try to look for that crate.

That's great, good to finally have someone around here who seems capable. Here's a piece and some ammunition for you, I'll send over my men's coordinates to your PDA. I'll radio them to let them know you're coming.
Look, frankly speaking, I don't think myself fit for this job now.
Aha, so, we save your ass from certain death and give you shelter, and you can't even do us a simple favor in return! Too high and mighty for the menial tasks, I see... Get lost, shithead!
I got the guts, but I won't go.
Yeah, like hell you do. Fine, get lost!
So, how is it going?
Your guys and I made it a-ok at the car park.
That's awesome, man! Here, take this. That's my personal reward for you.
We went over the car park with a fine-toothed comb. It's all clear now.
Wow! My men tell me you gave them a real beating! Here, take this money... Just a memento, not counting our huge gratitude. Plus, I got something else for you here...
Hey.
I'm working on it.
Keep me posted, ok?
I can't waste time on idle chit-chat. Take a hike!
I got that, I'm not stupid.
Hello, Marked One. What's the occasion?
Tell me something new, stalker.
What can I tell you. There were bandits at the car park, so we did some cleaning up. That's about it.
You aren't the bragging kind, are you! Look, since you've dealt with these thugs, I can't just let you go like that...
Thanks, brother! You did us a great service! I don't even know how to thank you...
Listen, I need that flash drive you were taking to the trader. Do you have it?
Yeah, I got it... Those morons can't even do a proper search. Well, what the heck, take it! After all, you saved my life. It was well hidden, but these thugs can't frisk for shit.
Thanks. Where did you keep it anyway? Who knows, might come in handy.

I didn't keep it down THERE so don't worry. I've worked for Trader for a long time so I can store information safely! By the way, I told the thugs a nice little story about a cache full of artifacts and they ordered one guy to go there. The cache exists, but it's only got one artifact. I can give you its coordinates if you want.
Have a safe trip, stalker!
Sure, thanks.
But don't forget: there's lots of wild animals there. Besides, the gangster they sent is armed with more than a scoop and a shovel, so be careful. Thanks, man.
Thanks to you, too.
Sure, no problem. Good luck!
Mission complete. Here's the box from the army outpost.

Good! You were a great help. But, of course a "thank you" won't buy you a loaf of bread. Here's three... wait, two thousand pieces of eight and we're square! By the way, the soldiers will certainly notice something missing, so things are going to heat up. You better get going, and the faster, the better.
Got any special missions for me?
Nope, not a thing.
What special missions? You haven't even finished the last one!

Well, here's the deal... A box containing the reports made by an expedition that went deep North into the Zone has been taken to the army outpost. By day, it's guarded as if it was filled with pure plutonium, but for some reason at night they only leave two guards.
Go on.
Sneak into the outpost quietly and "recover" the box. Do that and I'll pay you anything...within reason. Will you do it?
I'll try.
I'll get the cash ready - you haven't let me down once. Just one other thing... keep it low profile. If the military gets pissed off we're all in for a lot of trouble.
No, I can't take it on yet.
C'mon man, it's not as bad as it sounds. A bunch of drunk recruits green as grass with a single NCO...Well, OK, but I was really counting on you, Marked One...
Listen, Marked One... I've done some thinking, and here's what I'd like to offer... Generally speaking, what you really need is to find Strelok. Right?
Let's assume I do.

Anyway, here's the thing about Strelok. There's a stalker that goes by this name. They say he's found a path to the northern reaches of the Zone. And that is a virgin area, a real goldmine for artifacts... Yeah... Anyway, I can help you find him... However... As you can imagine, it won't be a free ride. You'll have to work it off... But in the long run we will both benefit: You're going to waste that Strelok fella and find out what's happened to you... And I'll find... well, I mean... I'll get my share of our mutual profit, he-he... So what do you say? Deal?
Go on.

Alright, listen... You mean business, I can see that... And I... I mean, we need guys like you. We're doing sort of an investigation with some other traders. We want to open up the path to the North, to the center of the Zone. And near the center someone or something is trying to hamper our progress... How the heck this Strelok managed to sneak through, I don't know... You see, there's this one area where your brain starts boiling. An eerie place... Anyway, to cut a long story short - a couple of guys have been spying on them grunts for me, not far from here. Apparently, the ones at the Agroprom Research Institute, have dug up something. Something major. I'm positive it has something to do with the center of the Zone. Anyway, whatever they've dug up, it's secured somewhere on the third floor of the Institute. And we really need this stuff. You see what I mean?
I think so.
Once you have the briefcase, don't bring it here. Take it straight to the Barman. He runs the stalker bar, the 100 Rads, I'll upload the coordinates and all the data you need to your PDA. Clear?
Gotcha.

You'll have to go North through the Garbage, then turn West. You'll end up at the Agroprom Research Institute after a few kilometers. And be careful, the radiation level is way too high at the Garbage. So I suggest you cough up for some anti-rad or vodka. Well, good luck.

Got a job for you, Marked One... I want you to find a stalker called Nimble, he was carrying some very important information. He disappeared somewhere near the bridge. Find him, dead or alive - I don't care, I need the flash drive with the info. Visit Wolf from the local camp, and ask him. He certainly knows where that guy can be.
Is that it?
Hey Marked One, what's up?
Marked One, what are you doing here? I told you to find Nimble!
So, you paid X-18 a visit? Got the documents?
Yeah. Here they are.

Well, well... I see... Now that's interesting, very interesting! If I told anyone they wouldn't believe me! Hmm... Yeah... Oh! Would you just look at that! I didn't expect this... it's pretty bad, eh... Well, here take these back and give them to the Barkeep. Oh, and I owe you for your efforts.

Wait. Here, take this pistol and ammo. You won't last two seconds in the Zone without a weapon! By the way, when you were brought here, you had a knife. I took it off you just in case your head wasn't quite working. You look OK though, so here it is.
Thank you.
So Marked One, any progress on our mutual business?
The choice is yours. Either I brainwash you like I usually do with all the rookies or I treat you like a real stalker and give you a mission straight away.
Hey, Marked One! Good timing, I've got a little job for you.
Treat me like a rookie, I don't remember shit.
Just give me a mission.

Got a job for you, Marked One... I want you to find a stalker called Nimble, he was carrying some very important information. He disappeared somewhere near the bridge. Find him, dead or alive - I don't care, I need the flash drive with the info. Visit Wolf from the local camp, and ask him. He certainly knows where that guy can be.
Go on.
That's all for now. Bring me the flash drive and we'll consider the fact that you've partially paid me for saving you.
OK, I'll try.
Hey, Marked One. Glad to see you alive.
Greetings, Marked One! Did you manage?
Task complete. Here's the artifact.
Great, Marked One. One more little favor and we're even.
What favor?
The situation has been resolved.
